channel.title: Hacker News Daily
channel.description: An unofficial, personal daily audio summary of Hacker News discussions, made for Scott Mills. Each episode picks the day's top tech stories (AI and local LLMs, coding tools, Apple, hardware, gadgets, startups) and summarizes what the articles say and what commenters argued about. AI-narrated. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hacker News or Y Combinator. Links to the original stories and threads are in the show notes.

item.title: Hacker News Daily — Oct 29, 2026: Gemini 4 Carbon, touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and M6, Claude Code's hidden token burn, macOS git trusts compromised certs, Ghostty 1.4, Stack Overflow's decline
item.description:
Hacker News Daily: Gemini 4 Carbon, touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and M6, Claude Code's hidden token burn, macOS git trusts compromised certs, Ghostty 1.4, Stack Overflow's decline.

Gemini 4 Carbon (HN discussion) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50276792

  • Google blog: Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon — https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-carbon/
  • Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50288019
  • Artificial Analysis article — https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/gemini-4-carbon-new-number-1

MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50276940

  • Apple: PROLED XDR display page — https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/
  • New 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50261352
  • Apple Newsroom: 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 — https://www.apple.com/in/newsroom/2026/10/apple-introduces-the-new-14-inch-macbook-pro-with-m6/

Claude Code regularly sends each background agent's transcript to its model (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50284255

  • Write-up and unofficial patch (gist) — https://gist.github.com/flamerix-ai/c3905705cc4205e5de3011fa2e74efce

Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50271640

  • Researcher write-up — https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/apple.html
  • Apple support note (linked by commenters) — https://support.apple.com/en-us/149555

Ghostty 1.4 (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50261998

  • Release notes — https://ghostty.org/docs/install/release-notes/1-4-0

StackOverflow now gets fewer than 1000 questions a month (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50282454

  • Stack Exchange Data Explorer query — https://data.stackexchange.com/stackoverflow/query/1926661

Quick hits

  • Survival LLM: offline AI assistant and emergency library (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50264853
  • Survival LLM site — https://www.brangus.io/survival-llm
  • Raspberry Pi Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A spotted in device trees (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50265594
  • bret.dk article — https://bret.dk/raspberry-pi-zero-3-w-pi-4-model-a/
  • Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware threatens most servers (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50265393
  • Ars Technica article — https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/code-execution-flaw-in-uefi-firmware-threatens-most-servers-on-planet-earth/
  • Qwenputer: a RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5 (HN) — https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50282838
  • Qwenputer blog post — https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer

Unofficial personal summary of public Hacker News discussions; not affiliated with Hacker News or Y Combinator. Claims are as reported by the linked sources and commenters.
